messages:
mira: Pushed a dark-mode swatch update to the branch (liminal-ink-swatch). Main goals: make code panes feel 'ink-like' without losing chart contrast. Quick notes and screenshots in PR.
aj: Saw it — love the depth on the panels. A couple quick nits: the gutter vs code-bg contrast falls below 4.5:1 for small UI text. Can we bump gutter to #13161a?
lee: Agree on gutter. Also, token heatmap colors? The blue→teal ramp feels too saturated on low-value bins. Suggest desaturating the lower stops and increase mid stops' luminance.
zoe: Accessibility check: tooltip text on charts needs 3:1 relative to tooltip bg. Current tooltip bg (#132028) with white text is borderline when the tooltip has a 90% alpha over the panel.
sam: Proposed small patch:
```
--panel-bg: #0b1114
--gutter: #13161a  /* bump for 4.7:1 */
--code-bg: #071018
--code-fg: #e6eef3
--heat-stop-1: #0a3b4a
--heat-stop-3: #2aa6b0
```
mira: thanks — that looks promising. For syntax highlighting, I tested `keyword` vs `function` colors in long SQL snippets; keyword gets lost in folded state. Maybe push keyword to slightly warmer #ffd6a5?
aj: Warmer keyword helps, but watch token visuals in error states (red underline). We should avoid warm keywords that collide with error red.
zoe: Also propose a thin stroke for chart axes at 28% alpha of text color instead of a hard hex. Keeps contrast consistent across themes.
lee: Implementation question: are we doing separate palette for mini-graphs (sparklines) in tables? If they share the same scale, small bars become indistinguishable.
mira: Good point — let's use a 'micro' variant with higher saturation and 1.2x luminance for sparklines. I'll add a new variable set: `--micro-heat-*` in the patch.
design-bot: Contrast report generated: 12 elements failing AA small text, 3 failing AA large text. Drift mainly in gutters, tooltip overlays, and low-value heatmap stops. Full report: /link (internal)
aj: Ok next steps: mira to update PR with gutter+tooltip fix, lee to prototype micro-variant for sparklines, zoe to run quick a11y pass after PR. Sam will review syntax weights.
mira: On it. Will ping when updated. :white_check_mark:
